# NaFT MRV Core

Read AGENTS.md first. This branch is Version-aware MRV Evidence Compiler + Re-verification Engine. Source is build-free vanilla JS in src/*.js, loaded by naft-app.html.

Preserve exact-version snapshots, SHA-256, explicit exception decisions/final attestation, duplicate/overlap and stale/tamper guards. Machine checks and draft construction do not require routine approvals. Never automate formal certification. Keep CONFIG REQUIRED and null certified result.

Do not restore removed domains, external SDKs or financial/registry operations. Keep page rendering read-only and HTML escaped. Run bash tests/run.sh and synchronize documentation. Test count follows surviving domain responsibilities, never dead code.

Keep official unknowns fail-closed; preserve reference versions. Synthetic Pack transitions and Corpus KPIs must never be represented as institutional or field validation. Impact analysis includes newly added rules and binds successor graphs to retained historical packages. See docs/architecture.md for the pure/session API boundary.
